problem: The RNA-seq input labelled NA07000 is not a Geuvadis sample. It is the only development subject-assay absent from cohorts/official_1000g_assay_manifest.tsv, and its RNA-seq HLA calls disagree with the same subject's WES calls at every gene. The benchmark had no sample-identity quality control.

evidence.manifest_membership: Of 237 subject-assays in data/development/normalized_caller_calls.tsv, exactly one is absent from the official assay manifest: (NA07000, rnaseq). NA07000 is listed for wes and wgs only.

cross_assay_hla_identity.method: Truth-free. For every subject typed in both assays, compare the ChampHLA-Consensus genotype from WES with that from RNA-seq at every gene called in both, at all requested loci (not only truth-retained loci), and count shared alleles (0-2 per gene).
cross_assay_hla_identity.flagged: NA07000 shares 1 of 6 alleles, at the level expected for unrelated individuals. The next lowest, NA20516 (4 of 6), shares alleles at every gene, which is consistent with caller error rather than a different individual.
cross_assay_hla_identity.role: Corroborating evidence only. No discordance threshold is used as an exclusion criterion, because any threshold would be chosen after seeing this distribution.

evidence.review_observation: WES calls for NA07000 (5/5 callers) agree with the 2014 reference typing; RNA-seq calls (3/4 callers) give a different genotype at every gene.

rule.exclusion_criterion: A subject-assay input is admitted only if it appears in cohorts/official_1000g_assay_manifest.tsv. A listed exclusion is recorded in configs/identity_exclusions.json with its reason and this decision. Any input that is neither in the manifest nor listed fails the pipeline (fail closed), so an unmanifested input can never enter silently. This also protects the confirmatory extension.

excluded.subject: NA07000
excluded.reason: input absent from the official assay manifest; RNA-seq HLA genotype discordant with the subject's WES genotype at every gene

rule.retained: NA07000 WES is in the manifest and is retained.
rule.provenance: Excluded rows are moved to data/development/excluded_caller_calls.tsv and excluded_secondary_calls.tsv, not deleted. The identity check is regenerated by the gate into artifacts/development_characterisation/identity_check.tsv for every subject, including excluded ones.

expected_impact_known_before_signature.statement: Not blind: the review computed the effect, and the two NA07000 RNA-seq loci at the exact endpoint are known consensus errors. Excluding them therefore raises RNA-seq concordance. The decision rests on provenance, not on that effect, and the manuscript must state both.
expected_impact_known_before_signature.expected: RNA-seq exact-endpoint denominator 120 -> 118 loci; requested RNA-seq loci and subject counts fall by one subject's loci. The regenerated registry is authoritative.

reporting_commitments: Methods describes the identity check (manifest membership plus cross-assay HLA concordance) and states that it was added after the development results were known.
Results/cohort flow reports the exclusion and the full concordance distribution.
The value with NA07000 included is reported once as a sensitivity statement, so the effect of the exclusion is visible.
